label: 整理登录模块
existing_saved_selection: preserve; do not silently enable the new option
heading_sources: typed Arabic or Chinese heading numbers
unambiguous plain chapter names and bracketed subsection titles
target: second logical top-level body heading; if only one exists, allow an explicit function or operation chapter; otherwise manual review
existing_login_section: preserve structure, heading and images; normalize only instruction typography when it differs from the dominant ordinary body signature
existing_section_priority: scan Word and plain-text login heading variants before pairing or relocation; existing login sections with intervening introduction text or multiple images remain intact; uncertain or multiple login headings require manual review and prohibit insertion
candidate: one explicit login instruction paragraph plus one uniquely adjacent standalone inline image; allow up to three ordinary empty paragraphs; recognize either original order
write: insert a 登录页 subsection before the original first subsection; retain that subsection and all its content; move login paragraph then image under the new heading
numbering: continue the same Word numbering chain; increment typed sibling prefixes and dependent descendants only within the target chapter; ambiguous or shared body-list numbering requires manual review
preservation: move complete OOXML paragraphs and self-contained bookmarks; verify the expected paragraph multiset and non-document.xml member SHA-256 values before atomic replacement
unsupported: multiple plausible login paragraphs or adjacent images
login paragraph mixed with headings, tables, fields, tracked edits, or drawings
review_policy: preserve login location on uncertainty; report in red; continue other documents and keep unrelated successful repairs; batch status is partial when an item needs manual handling

performance.preview: read structure XML only; do not load media
performance.word: use existing global lock and batch session; one open/save/export per changed document
performance.login_only_unchanged: skip Word and retain existing DOCX/PDF unless PDF export was explicitly requested

final_checks: re-identify the saved independent login section
readable PDF with page count equal to Word
saved login instruction typography matches dominant body reference when resolvable
checkpoint_identity: include rule_version when the option is selected

typography.target: login instruction runs only; new and existing standalone login sections
typography.reference: dominant homogeneous ordinary body paragraphs, minimum 15 characters, at least 2 paragraphs, no tied first place; exclude cover, headings, TOC, tables, drawings, numbered lists and the login instruction
typography.resolution: document defaults, paragraph/character style inheritance and toggles, direct run properties, theme fonts with known language/script
typography.uncertainty: report manual review without guessing; may retain a completed safe structural repair
typography.preservation: keep text, paragraph properties, headings, images, color and other run attributes
typography.performance: reuse heading analysis; XML-only; zero extra Word opens/OCR/model calls
